name: Mohammadhossein Amouei
intro: I study how machine learning can help us understand and secure software when source code is unavailable.
bio: I am a PhD candidate at McGill University, supervised by Prof. Benjamin C. M. Fung. My research brings together software reverse engineering, natural language processing, and representation learning.

I focus on binary code similarity: identifying related functions across compilers, optimization settings, and architectures. My broader interests include language models for code and learning-guided vulnerability discovery.

research.title: Binary code similarity
research.text: Representations that capture function semantics despite changes introduced by compilation and optimization.

research.title: Language models for code
research.text: Adapting language models to assembly and source code for retrieval, representation learning, and program understanding.

research.title: Learning-guided security
research.text: Machine learning methods for vulnerability discovery and adaptive testing of software defenses.
